question.text: Fund TI (Irrevocable Determinate Trust) with business income of Rs. 6.11 crore pays tax at:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Example 1, Scenario A: 30% tax + 25% surcharge + 4% cess = ~39% effective. On Rs. 6.11 crore business income, net tax ~Rs. 2.38 crore.
